title: Restricted adjunctions on $\Dctf$
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be admissible and $f:X\to Y$ separated of finite type. On the
full subcategories $\Dctf(-,\Lambda)$:

1. $f^*\dashv Rf_*$, as the restriction of the adjunction on
   $D(-_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$;
2. $-\otimes^{\mathbf L}K\dashv\cHom(K,-)$ for $K\in\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$, as the
   restriction of the tensor–Hom adjunction on $D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$;
3. $Rf_!\dashv f^!$, as the restriction of the adjunction on
   $\Loc(\Dctf(-,\Lambda))$ of [sk-prop-sf-existence].

proof.text: For fully faithful inclusions iA and iB, construct the restricted adjunction with Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful and prove the exact ambient Hom formula using restrictFullyFaithful_homEquiv_apply, map_preimage, homEquiv_unit, map_comp and associativity. This is the proved private helper compatible_of_fullyFaithful. For preserved object properties, compatible_of_preserves constructs both functors with ObjectProperty.lift and identity comparison isomorphisms.

Apply the pullback and direct-image preservation clauses of [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images] to the ambient adjunction [def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull-adjunction], and use the preceding full-subcategory restriction construction. This gives clause 1, including the ambient Hom bijections.

For each K in Dctf, transport derivedTensorHomAdjunction along the derived signed tensorLeftIsoTensorRight to give the stated right-factor tensor functor. Apply the tensor preservation clause of det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images with arguments M,K. The first clause of internalHom_stability, restored with its existing node and complete statement, supplies Hom preservation. Apply compatible_of_preserves; its Hom equation gives the required compatibility.

Use the same chosen compactification c0 as constructibleFiniteTor_stability_direct_images and give its open part the quasi-compactness proof from quasiCompact_openImmersion_iff. Apply exists_localizingExceptionalAdjoint at c0, and its final two preservation clauses from the direct-image stability theorem, to construct the small functors F0 and G0 using ObjectProperty.lift. The inclusions in the localizing closures are the canonical ObjectProperty.ιOfLE. For any boundary compactification c, obtain its preservation witness from the same existence theorem. Lift compactification_coherence_cocycle from ambient targets through the fully faithful target inclusion, obtaining e : F_c0 ≅ F_c. Transport the ambient adjunction with ofNatIsoLeft e, keeping its right adjoint G. Apply compatible_of_fullyFaithful using F0,G0, the left comparison isoWhiskerLeft iX e and identity right comparison. This proves clause 3 with the actual localizingLowerShriek. CompactSpace and QuasiSeparatedSpace for Y follow from its finite-type separated structure morphism. Invoke the current compactification coherence theorem with its explicit ground-field argument k; the old compiled-signature fallback is no longer needed.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q90-bd9f09beb (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item, its single proof step and every cited node in full, plus the main-20261015 statement and proof files. The statement matches the source exactly; no hypothesis is added, dropped or weakened. Coefficient category: D(X_proét,Λ)=D(Mod_{Λ_X}) (sk-def-localizing-closure). Dctf sits inside it as a full subcategory (sk-def-sfb-constructible), and Loc(Dctf) is a full subcategory of the same category that contains Dctf, so all three clauses are restrictions along full inclusions. The full-subcategory restriction lemma is correct. Clause checks: (1) the ambient adjunction Lf^*⊣Rf_* is def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull-adjunction, and preservation is direct-images (1),(3). (2) The ambient adjunction is sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom layer B; preservation is direct-images (1) for ⊗ and det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-internal-hom for cHom. (3) The ambient adjunction is sk-prop-sf-existence on Loc(Dctf) with Rf_!=Rp_*D(j_!) over the standing schemes of sk-def-sfb-dc-setting; preservation is direct-images (3),(4), whose (4) uses explicit preservation statements, not existence alone. A reachability check shows the DAG is acyclic. Edge cases checked: empty X, K=0, f=id, field coefficients, proper f (consistent with det-cor-existence-ii-restriction). There are no new nodes. There are no duplicates: def-sfb-dc-upper-lower-adjunction and def-sfb-dc-tensor-hom-adjunction are about D_cons, not Dctf. I accept the tool use of sk-prop-sf-existence, which the blueprint node itself cites; the two definition entries are notions and harmless. Fixes: (a) added the missing stmt_deps sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, sk-def-sfb-constructible, sk-def-localizing-closure and sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull; (b) wrote out in the step the swap from the ambient K⊗−⊣RHom(K,−) to the stated −⊗K⊣cHom(K,−), via the commutative Koszul-signed symmetry of ⊗_{Λ_X} on a K-flat resolution. Details are in review.md.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer

theorem podGeneralCtfAdjunctions
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    (_hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ) :
    WeilConjectures.podCompatibleRestriction (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ f)
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ Y ⊓
        fun K ↦ _root_.DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K).ι
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X ⊓
        fun K ↦ _root_.DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K).ι ∧
    (∀ K : ConstantModelConstructibleFiniteTor Λ X,
      WeilConjectures.podCompatibleRestriction
        ((derivedTensorHomAdjunction Λ K.obj).ofNatIsoLeft
          (@BraidedCategory.tensorLeftIsoTensorRight _ _ _
            (_root_.DerivedCategory.braidedCategory' _) K.obj))
        (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X ⊓
          fun M ↦ _root_.DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ M).ι
        (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X ⊓
          fun M ↦ _root_.DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ M).ι) ∧
    (∀ c : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f,
      ∃ (h : ∀ K, localizingClosureProEtale Λ X K → localizingClosureProEtale Λ Y
          ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c.obj.obj).obj K))
        (G : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ Y).FullSubcategory ⥤
          (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory)
        (adj : localizingLowerShriek Λ c.obj.obj h ⊣ G),
        WeilConjectures.podCompatibleRestriction adj
          (ObjectProperty.ιOfLE (fun K hK _P _hP hSP ↦ hSP K hK) :
            ConstantModelConstructibleFiniteTor Λ X ⥤
              (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory)
          (ObjectProperty.ιOfLE (fun K hK _P _hP hSP ↦ hSP K hK) :
            ConstantModelConstructibleFiniteTor Λ Y ⥤
              (localizingClosureProEtale Λ Y).FullSubcategory))
